items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: You know Dave Bailey, a drummer.

ctx.x: The talk boy? The talk boy. That's right. That's right. You heard him. That's right. He's a cracker

jack. He's been dead. His sister's living now, Thomas Benton's sister. Is she in his neighborhood? Yeah. She lives at, let me see, she lives 3924 Magnolia Street now. 3924 Magnolia? Yeah, Thomas Benton's sister. I was talking to her yesterday. And she's glad to see me. She hadn't seen me in 50 years until yesterday. Oh she's up near Dave Bailey. You know Dave Bailey, a drummer. Yeah, she hadn't seen me 50 years until yesterday. And she told me to come see us sometime. And I just played her brother years ago.…

Yeah, well that bank book you showed me, it says, sort of proves that. Let's see, it has a date here, doesn't it? Yeah, I guess that's your wife's deposit. March 16th, 1953, Miss? Cecile Armacar. Cecile Armacar. I see. That's all. That proves that, don't it? That proves you got a good memory, man. Well now, let's see. When you went to Chicago, what kind of music did they have up there?
